Package ch.zhaw.it.pm3.occupi.util

package ch.zhaw.it.pm3.occupi.util
Provides utility classes for the Occupi application.

This package contains helper classes and utility functions that are used across the application to support common operations such as file I/O, data conversion, and other shared functionality.

Key classes:

  • JsonReader - Generic JSON file reader and writer
